overview: Server C monitoring stack — Prometheus, Grafana, and Traefik with GitHub OAuth. All hostnames, secrets, and OAuth credentials are entered interactively at setup time.
prerequisites: Domain name and DNS for Grafana/Prometheus hostnames
GitHub OAuth app (Client ID and Secret) if using GitHub login

steps.title: Install Docker host (if needed)
steps.command: sudo apt install himosoft-docker-host && sudo himosoft-docker-host install

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-monitor-host

steps.title: Initialize monitoring stack
steps.body: Prompts for install directory, domain names, GitHub OAuth, and Prometheus scrape targets.

notes: All values entered at prompt — nothing pre-filled
Deploy node-exporter on servers you want to scrape
Point DNS to this server before accessing Grafana
